provenance: Fresh synthetic falsification cases labelled before symbol-diversity runs: useful direct notes compete with an irrelevant callee note, cross-file callee, and a two-hop rationale. Not an independent effectiveness holdout.

memories.title: Record boundary
memories.body: External consumers require a trailing newline.

memories.title: Legacy ordering
memories.body: Older clients expect the original field sequence.

memories.title: Embedded delimiters
memories.body: Quotation marks must be doubled inside strings.

memories.title: Absent values
memories.body: Missing entries use the literal null token.

memories.title: Diagnostic sampling
memories.body: Emit tracing events for one percent of invocations.

queries.question: Which compatibility constraints govern encode_payload output?
queries.rationale: All four wire-format decisions apply to output compatibility. Sampling internal traces does not.

memories.title: Peer lifetime
memories.body: The remote session expires after one minute. Longer pauses abandon the connection.

queries.question: Why does send_packet cap the backoff at sixty seconds?
queries.rationale: The peer lifetime explains the cap; fiscal history is unrelated.
